title: git kura seal unclaim — envelope data
description: Command-specific schema for the data payload of `git kura seal unclaim --json <path...>`, nested under the common envelope's data field. seal unclaim is all-or-nothing: either all paths are processed or none are.

currentKey.description: The key derived from the current managed worktree.

status.description: released: claim was removed. not-claimed: path was not in the seal store (idempotent).
